test_route.test_route: Codex -> actual Mulder MCP -> forensic tools/native parsers -> retained Ancalor case records -> GUI review/reports
test_route.backend_role: Stores evidence/results, searches/filters, provenance/coverage/findings and exports; GUI calls backend for these operations.
test_route.current_gui_route: GUI review operates on retained cases; Codex-driven MCP execution is distinct from the legacy autonomous GUI engine-launch adapter.
test_route.tests_role: Known source fixtures prove narrow capabilities, while software controls test boundaries/failure handling. Case-test completion is not device-wide support.
test_route.priority: Direct pipeline case/capability gaps first; operational and human release tracks reported separately.

evidence_case_tests.description: Run specific lab/customer fixtures through Mulder and verify source fields, search, interpretation, replay and reports. Directly validates our pipeline.

pipeline_capabilities.description: Implement and test evidence storage, parsers, search, provenance, coverage, reports, collection and job handling. This backend supplies the GUI.

technical_operations.description: Transfer/access, component licenses, backups/retention and data-processing defaults. Supports safe operation, distinct from parser accuracy.

examiner_and_business_release.description: Blind human workflow/reviewer qualification and signed service release. Separate from verified software capability and never a blanket blocker on other technical tickets.

time_estimate: Not inferred from ticket count; remaining scopes vary and many have partial passing evidence.
